title: Alkhidmat Food Package (Ration)

address: Alkhidmat Foundation Head Office, 3km Khayaban-e-Jinnah, Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan
eligibility: Families living below the poverty line
documents: Other documents requested by the local Alkhidmat office
application: Contact or visit the nearest Alkhidmat Foundation office or local distribution center. Beneficiaries are identified and verified through local teams and welfare networks.

title: Alkhidmat Ramadan Food Pack
description: A Ramadan food assistance initiative providing essential food supplies to vulnerable and deserving families during Ramadan.
address: Alkhidmat Foundation Head Office, 3km Khayaban-e-Jinnah, Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan
eligibility: Families living below the poverty line
application: Beneficiaries can contact their nearest Alkhidmat office or local Ramadan Food Hub. Local teams conduct need-based verification before distribution.

title: Alkhidmat Ramadan Relief Food Program
type: Ration Distribution and Free Iftar Meals
description: Alkhidmat Ramadan relief activities include ration distribution, roadside iftar points and Iftar Dastarkhwan for low-income families, laborers and travelers.
address: Alkhidmat Foundation Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Peshawar, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan
support: Subsidized bread through Sasti Roti initiatives
eligibility: People unable to reach home before Iftar
documents: Proof of residence for ration assistance
application: For ration assistance, contact the local Alkhidmat office or distribution point. Free roadside Iftar and Dastarkhwan meals are generally provided directly at designated locations without a formal application.

title: Saylani Dastarkhwan
description: Saylani Welfare's Dastarkhwan program provides freshly prepared nutritious meals through distribution centers for people facing food insecurity.
address: Saylani Welfare International Trust, A-25 Bahadurabad Chowrangi, Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan
support: Food assistance for people facing financial hardship
application: No formal application is generally required for receiving meals. Visit a designated Saylani Dastarkhwan or food distribution center during operating hours.

title: Edhi Langar Service Free Kitchen
description: Edhi Foundation operates free kitchen and Langar services providing nutritious meals to hungry and underserved people.
address: Edhi Foundation Head Office, Mithadar, Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan
eligibility: Individuals unable to afford regular meals
application: No formal application is generally required for the free kitchen meal service. Visit an Edhi Langar or designated free-kitchen location.
locations: Other Edhi service locations across Pakistan

title: Edhi Food Bank and Family Food Pack
description: Edhi Foundation's food assistance services include family food packs, monthly food support and food distribution for people in need.
address: Edhi Foundation Head Office, Mithadar, Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan
eligibility: People affected by emergencies or disasters
application: Contact or visit the nearest Edhi Centre or relevant Edhi food assistance facility to inquire about available food packages and beneficiary registration.

title: Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal Khana Sab Ke Liye
description: Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal's Khana Sab Ke Liye initiative provides free food to needy citizens including laborers, daily wagers, travelers, students and other deserving people.
address: Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal Head Office, H-8/4, Islamabad, Pakistan
eligibility: People temporarily unable to earn a livelihood
application: Eligible individuals can obtain free food at designated Khana Sab Ke Liye food distribution points. The program is intended to provide food directly to deserving people and generally does not require a lengthy application.

title: Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal Shelter Home Food Support
description: Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal Shelter Homes provide accommodation and food support to deserving people, including meals served according to an established menu.
address: Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal Head Office, H-8/4, Islamabad, Pakistan
application: Visit a Pakistan Bait-ul-Mal Shelter Home and follow the local registration or admission procedure. Food is provided to eligible shelter residents according to the shelter-home policy.

title: Alkhidmat Disaster Ration Packages
description: Alkhidmat provides ration packages containing essential food items to communities affected by floods, earthquakes and other disasters.
address: Alkhidmat Foundation Head Office, 3km Khayaban-e-Jinnah, Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan
application: Contact the nearest Alkhidmat office or local disaster-relief distribution center. Beneficiaries are identified through local teams and emergency response operations.
